parsed.rationale: The ticket says the app is 'broken again' and 'Nothing works anymore,' referencing the same issue as last time, but it provides no specific symptoms, logs, affected workflow, or whether this is an outage vs a bug. The mention of a boss being mad suggests significant business impact, but details are insufficient to confidently categorize.

parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the note—sorry you’re running into this again and that it’s impacting your team. To get this investigated quickly, I need a few specifics since “nothing works” and “same as last time” aren’t enough for us to pinpoint the failing workflow.

Please reply with the following (copy/paste is fine):
1) What exact action/feature is failing? (e.g., “create invoice,” “log in,” “sync,” etc.)
2) Any error message text or error code you see (and where you see it in the UI).
3) When it started (date/time + your timezone) and whether it’s ongoing right now.
4) Where you’re seeing it: production vs sandbox, and the browser/device (or API client) if applicable.
5) The approximate time of the previous incident and/or the prior ticket number, if you have it.

If you can include a short screen recording or screenshots of the error, that would help a lot.

Once we have the above, we’ll route it to the right engineering team for investigation and follow-up.
promised_actions: Ask for minimum details to identify the failing workflow
Route the report to the appropriate engineering team for investigation and follow-up
safety_notes: Did not claim an outage status, root cause, or fix.
Did not promise a refund, SLA, or legal conclusion.
Acknowledged recurrence and impact, but required specific symptoms/workflow details before asserting anything further.
Framed as escalation/triage routing without claiming resolution.
